prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE flat children’s educational illustration, crisp shapes and simple solid colors. CACE N6: MUSSOL + DONAR + CÒMIC + NEN. Semantic focus: destinatari. Human appearance: recipient NEN is a boy aged 7. Correct age proportions. Exact scene: MUSSOL lliura CÒMIC a NEN. Còmic obert amb vinyetes mudes, passat amb cura de les mans del donant a les del receptor. Donant a l’esquerra amb gest d’oferiment; receptor a la dreta, orientat cap al donant, prenent el referent. Un sol objecte compartit en el traspàs, sense còpies ni accions paral·leles. Fons blanc sense escenari ni eina afegida. Donant antropomòrfic amable; és l’animal real del món fantàstic, no una joguina ni una persona disfressada. Pure white seamless background. WIDE SHOT, camera far away: entire people or animals INCLUDING FEET, every target object and ALL furniture legs fully in frame. Scale the complete composition small to fit the CENTRAL 65 percent of the canvas; leave a WHITE BORDER at least 12 percent wide on ALL FOUR sides. Never crop lower legs or desk legs. One action in one instant, no sequence or collage. Only essential support. Friendly school material. Absolutely NO text, letters, numerals, brands, logos, watermark, arrows or speech bubbles, including clothing and books. Humans wear ordinary clothes. Hands/paws make clear functional contact. No identifiable room or landscape. Exactly the named living participants, no spectators, no family group, no additional people or animals. Vary human skin and hair naturally: light skin, straight dark hair. Do not add plants, carpets or decorative accessories not required by the scene.
